title: How access cards work
goal: You know how to approve, narrow, deny and revoke

steps.title: What a card shows
steps.text: Each card shows who asks, for which task, what in plain words, why (in the agent's own words), the risks from the catalog, and the technical detail.

steps.title: Approve narrower
steps.text: You can always grant less than asked: a subfolder, fewer commands or hosts, a lower sandbox level, a shorter time. You can never grant more than asked.

steps.title: The live grants chip
steps.text: While any access is live, the header shows a chip with a Revoke button for each grant and Revoke all. Revoking stops running commands at once.

steps.title: Ready to try?
steps.question: Shall I send a small read-only request so you can see a card?

steps.title: Send a demo request
steps.reason: Demo request so you can see how an access card looks; deny it or approve it, either is fine.

steps.title: That is all
steps.text: You are in control of every grant.
